teacher_info.teaching_style:
My lessons almost always consist of: 
1. A warmup activity: usually discussing related topics, news, etc. using pictures or discussion questions.
2. A pre-reading or pre-video discussion.
3. Vocabulary for the reading or video.
4. This is when we read an article or watch a video.
5. I usually ask a few questions to make sure you understood everything. I also answer any questions you may have here as well.
6. We have a more in-depth discussion.
7. I'll give you some homework or mini-missions
8. We go over any mistakes and corrections that I have saved for the end of the lesson.
9. We schedule our next lesson and say goodbye! =)

teacher_info.intro: Hello! I love to help my students improve their pronunciation! It gives me a really good feeling to help my students. :)
teacher_info.about_me: Hello! I love to help my students improve their pronunciation! It gives me a really good feeling to help my students. :)
teacher_info.about_teacher: I have a very calm and encouraging teaching style. It's very important to me that my students feel comfortable as it will help them learn pronunciation much better. :)
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My teaching method is as follows:

Step 1: Choose one sound to improve. There are 44 sounds in American English, and the most important to pronounce accurately are: the "R" sound, the "short i", and the "short a".

Step 2: Learn how to create the sound. Know what your tongue and mouth should be doing.

Step 3: Drill the sound with the IPA until it is comfortable.

Step 4: Learn the most common words that use your target sound. 

Step 5: Practice simple sentences using the most common words.

Step 6: Advanced practice (paragraphs, minimal pairs, tongue twisters etc).

Step 7: Test the sound again. Do you still need more practice?

teacher_info.intro: I'm a businessman and teacher with over 40 years' experience. I find it rewarding to help others advance their careers, so I teach business English and job search, with a focus on Fearless Interviewing, I also advise businesses on their marketing strategy,  I've taught students from more than twenty-five countries, with China, Russia, Europe, and South America making up the majority.
teacher_info.short_signature: Helping Business Professionals Worldwide Advance Their Careers: Job Search and Business English
teacher_info.introduction:
Fact: Communicate fluently in Business English and you have a more successful career: more job opportunities, faster promotions, higher pay. 

Fact: If you want a new job, you must understand the process from the hiring company's eyes. Good experience is great to have, but it's not nearly enough. You must sell yourself effectively, in your cover letter, resume/CV, and in your interviews. Most people don't and miss out on great jobs.

Fact: Customized lessons deliver better, faster results, and are more fun to take. I develop each lesson specifically for a student's needs on that day. It takes extra time, but I do it for my select group of students, because it works. Period.

Fact: Your teacher's focus matters. I don't teach children or beginners, only business people. Why? It's what I do well.

Fact: Your teacher's training, experience, and commitment all matter. My extensive experience features over 35 years in business and over 5 as a professional teacher. I have degrees from Yale and Stanford and have taught students from more than 10 countries.

Opportunity: If this sounds like what you are looking for, send me a message. Let's see if we are right for each other.
teacher_info.about_me: I'm a businessman and teacher with over 40 years' experience. I find it rewarding to help others advance their careers, so I teach business English and job search, with a focus on Fearless Interviewing, I also advise businesses on their marketing strategy,  I've taught students from more than twenty-five countries, with China, Russia, Europe, and South America making up the majority.
teacher_info.about_teacher: About 10 years ago, I went back to school to learn how to be a professional teacher. After earning a master's degree, I taught for a time in a public school. Then, about 9 years ago, I started working with students online to help them improve their English, especially for business. Many of my students have gotten promotions or new jobs because of their skill improvement. While I'd like to help language learners at all levels and with all goals, I focus exclusively on students at the upper intermediate or advanced level who want to improve their language skills for business. Why? Because this is what I do best.
teacher_info.teaching_style: I teach two things: business English and job search. Both are designed to help you advance your career. While all lessons are customized for you, a typical business English lesson might include discussion of business-related articles, which I have chosen and sent to you in advance, We would work on vocabulary and pronunciation. Job search lessons vary based on what you need now: help with a CV or with interviewing. Frequently, after training you how to answer interview questions, we will practice the answers in a low stress setting. I'm easy to work with. I can see new students relax within the first 10 minutes of the first lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: Get a Better Job by Building a Compelling Resume/CV and Polishing Your Interviewing Skills
pro_course_detail.description: Do you want to open up the new opportunities that come with a new job? Let me help you build or refine a resume (CV) that gets attention and interviews. And then teach you a system that lets you handle any interview with confidence.

pro_course_detail.title: Everyday Business English for Intermediate and Advanced Students
pro_course_detail.description: Are you a business professional who wants to get ahead by improving your English? Let me help you learn and use the right terminology for your workplace.

pro_course_detail.title: Powerful Presentations That Get Results: Write and Deliver Them Like a Pro
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to communicate your ideas clearly and simply? Let me help you write and deliver compelling presentations and sales pitches that impress and convince your audience.

Ask most business people what frightens them the most and the most likely answer is "a presentation." You can get over this hurdle by following my easy-to-follow method, which I have used for hundreds of presentations during my career.

These presentations can be to one person, a small group, or a meeting room full of hundreds of people. To effectively sell your ideas, you need the right content, supported by the right visuals, presented in the right way. 

Bring your draft, or even just your ideas, to me and we'll get started making you a "Presentation Pro."

pro_course_detail.title: Writing to Impress - Improve Your Business Writing: Emails, Customer Correspondence, Inter-Company Communications, and More
pro_course_detail.description:
Write well and people, both inside and outside your company, have a higher opinion of you and your overall skills. This leads to more sales and to having more of your ideas being accepted and implemented.

People see your written work every day, in emails and other documents. Some people only know you from this writing, as you may rarely get the opportunity to speak with them directly.

Writing these well is different than speaking well. It demands a broader vocabulary and more attention to organization, of the whole document, of paragraphs, of sentences.

We can work on the actual documents you have written and those you need to write, so you get real-world, relevant, hands-on practice in a risk-free situation. You will learn general principles about good writing in English and about how to manage the details of writing: word choice, punctuation, spelling, proper use of paragraphs.

Write me a note and we'll get started.

pro_course_detail.title: Networking: Be Comfortable and Confident in Social Business Situations
pro_course_detail.description: Do you sometimes find it hard to talk to new people? Do you lack confidence in your ability to network and form new relationships? You're not alone. These situations can be uncomfortable for everyone. Let me teach you how to act and what to say so you make a good impression and get people to want to know you better.

pro_course_detail.title: Informal Tutoring
pro_course_detail.description: Do you have a specific business meeting or situation you’d like to discuss? We can improve your ability to think through problems and to present solutions.

teacher_info.about_teacher: I have over 13 years of experience in the classroom both as a teacher and teacher's assistant. I have worked with children ranging in ages 3 to 18. I have also taught over 5,000 ESL classes online.  I have a bachelor's degree and am certified in both TESOL and TEFL.
teacher_info.teaching_style: I believe that learning should be both educational and fun. I use a lot of TPR (total physical response) and props to help reinforce my lessons. My lessons will be tailored to meet the needs of my students. The lessons that I offer are interactive and based on the CEFR/Cambridge model. I also offer leveled reading using RAZ KIDS for English language learners, Wonders and Power Up (Cambridge). If you are unsure of your child's correct level, you can schedule a trial for your child's English speaking ability to be assessed. This can be done for both the leveled reading and regular English classes. Please fill out the teacher contact form prior to requesting new trials.

course_info.trial_description: My trial lessons will assess your child's basic English skills including grammar, reading, phonics and conversational skills. It will also provide a fun and relaxed opportunity to meet me and get to know my teaching style! For all trial classes, I will use a leveled reading lesson in order to properly assess your child. After the trial, you may choose either Raz Kids, Wonders or Reach Higher for regular lessons.

pro_course_detail.title: Guided Reading- 25 minutes/ 40 minutes
pro_course_detail.description: This course uses Raz Kids leveled readers, along with interactive Google Slide presentations. Raz Kids lessons include a different leveled reader (both fiction and nonfiction stories are used), vocabulary, sight words, grammar, phonics, and more.  If you are unsure of your child's correct reading level, it can be assessed in class. These classes are available in both 25 and 40 minute formats.

pro_course_detail.title: Guided Reading (25/40 minutes)
pro_course_detail.description: This course uses Raz Kids leveled readers, along with interactive Google Slide presentations (Zoom /Koala Go platform only). If using the Italki classroom, the lessons will not be interactive. Raz Kids lessons include a different leveled reader (both fiction and nonfiction stories are used), vocabulary, sight words, grammar, phonics, and more.  If you are unsure of your child's correct reading level, it can be assessed in class. These classes are available in both 25 and 40 minute formats.

pro_course_detail.title: English (Beginner to Intermediate) 25/40 minutes
pro_course_detail.description:
Beginner lessons are designed for children who are just beginning their English language journey. Lessons are 25 minutes and feature an interactive lesson that focuses on the 26 letters of the alphabet, phonics, sight words, numbers and more!
Elementary to intermediate courses contain interactive lessons based on the CEFR/Cambridge model with a wide range of topics including animals, jobs, travel, food, school, clothing, body and many more! We will also practice important parts of the English language such as phonics, adjectives, numbers, pronouns, demonstratives, capitalization, regular plurals, present continuous, possessive pronouns, prepositions, and simple past/future throughout the units. All lessons are designed for kids. 
*These lessons are designed to be interactive and work best using platforms such as Zoom or Koala Class/Koala Go. Other platforms may be used but the interactive functions (such as drawing/drag and drop) may not be available.

pro_course_detail.title: ESL Literature (Wonders and Reach Higher)
pro_course_detail.description: In these courses, your child will be exposed to a variety of literature genres. We will also practice grammar, phonics and writing skills. These private classes are designed for children who are studying English as a second language.

When I retired, I taught Spanish for 5 years in 2 universities. I have a Masters plus 60 credits. I love teaching and also learning languages. I am currently learning Portuguese, Italian, and French. teacher_info.about_teacher:
TEFL + TESOL Certified English expression coach - accent, TOEFL prep, speaking, intonation, grammar, vocabulary. 
I am a online English teacher, focusing on your ability to express yourself the way you want, using the English language.

In 2013, I was the lead vocalist of a rock band. In order to pronounce the lyrics like the original singers, I taught myself the American accent. It took me a while to integrate it into my speech properly, but over time, I developed it to my liking. And that is what I am offering to you: to help you express yourself in the way you choose.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
In my lessons,I offer essential tools that help you in communication -- accent, intonation, emphasis, posture, attitude, et cetera. I want to remove any hesitation that you might feel when you want to speak English. My goal is for you to count English as a strength, not an obstacle.

The environment of the lesson will always be extremely humane and wholesome , to organically promote healthy bonds and confidence. 

The way we express ourselves includes a lot of connected factors, all of which are relevant. I am dedicated to giving time to understand the context behind the learner's challenges, so we approach them with care and compassion.
